rows.question: Which three risk factors are most specific to this company's business (rather than generic to any public company)? Summarize each in one sentence.
rows.answer: (1) BILL Divvy Card credit risk: BILL bears credit risk on card balances from spending businesses, and its proprietary risk models may fail to predict creditworthiness, leading to losses if businesses default or file for bankruptcy (since BILL doesn't file UCC liens on card balances). (3) Convertible notes conversion risk: the conditional conversion features of the 2027 and 2030 Notes could force BILL to settle conversions in cash (hurting liquidity) or reclassify the notes as current liabilities, materially reducing net working capital.

rows.question: Which three risk factors are most specific to this company's business (rather than generic to any public company)? Summarize each in one sentence.
rows.answer: (1) Rapid7's revenue growth depends heavily on existing customers renewing and expanding subscriptions to its term-based platform offerings, so any decline in renewal or upsell rates directly hurts results. (2) The company's strategy hinges on customers adopting its 'consolidated platform sales approach' and Command Platform and related consolidation offerings; if this go-to-market shift or new product bundling fails to gain market acceptance, financial results and competitive position suffer.
